en: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David.

zh: 在上帝保佑中安穩自在
大衛的詩，照耶杜頓的作法，交與伶長。

ja: 指揮者のために。エドトンのために。ダビデの詩。

p.src: 1  My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

en: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
u.src: 1  My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

p.src: 2  He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

en: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.
u.src: 2  He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

p.src: 3  How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

ja: いつまであなたがたは
en: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
u.src: 3  How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

p.src: 4  They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

ja: きずり下ろそうと企む。
en: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
u.src: 4  They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

p.src: 5  My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

en: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.
u.src: 5  My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

p.src: 6  He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

en: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
u.src: 6  He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

p.src: 7  My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

en: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.
u.src: 7  My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

p.src: 8  Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

en: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.
u.src: 8  Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

p.src: 9  Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

ja: りである。 はかりに
せれば上がってしまい、 皆合わせても
en: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.
u.src: 9  Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

p.src: 10  Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

ja: してはならない。 強
いてはならない。 富が増しても、 それに心を留めてはならない。
en: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
u.src: 10  Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

p.src: 11  God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

en: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
u.src: 11  God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

p.src: 12  Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

en: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
u.src: 12  Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.
